name: bitrouter
description: Route model calls and browse durable BRO conversations in native scrollback. Run Thread/Turn conversations with FIFO input, steering, Codex-style AGENTS.md startup context and nested rules, six native tools (read, glob, grep, write, edit, shell), bounded read workers, configured MCP client tools, skills discovery and durable execution records on a background server. Bundles the BitRouter setup and operations skill, including native ACP v1/v2 via bro acp serve, external ACP harnesses, request checks, and custom-host setup.
